title.narrative: Total Population benefitting from improved access to wastewater services (Osh Karasuu)

description.narrative: Works to be conducted include the wastewater treatment plan (WWTP) upgrade in Karasuu (subproject 1), the modernisation of the WWTP in Osh (subproject 2) and the upgrade of the WWTP in KyzylKiya (subproject 4). Taken from the LF, phrasing revised.

comment.narrative: The watersanitation infrastructure rehabilitation project used civil works as one of its main strategy of intervention. The works will cover the different elements of the water supply and wastewater treatment systems. The population benefiting from improved wastewater treatment plants and facilities is a standard outcome of the rehabilitation works supported by the project. Baseline value is set as 93000 people with the presentation of the indicator in the paragraph 5 of the EXPECTED RESULTS of the DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION of the DELEGATION AGREEMENT ACA2016378430 page 15 IT page.
